period.static_features: September 2026 OSM inventory used as an explicitly estimated static surrogate for this period; historical road changes are not reconstructed.
period.dynamic_features: Historical provider weather records plus date/hour-specific traffic estimates; not 8760 independent traffic observations.
period.flood_risk: Static mapped NOAH hazard exposure proxy, not observed hourly flooding.

distance.local_evidence: WGS84 geodesic length of OSM geometry; 2026 map is a temporal surrogate.
distance.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

traffic_congestion.local_evidence: 1 - 1/(1 + alpha*(V/C)^beta). V/C profiles, road-type factors and weekend factor are project assumptions, not measurements.
traffic_congestion.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

travel_time.local_evidence: t = (length / free-flow speed) * (1 + 0.15*(V/C)^4) / (1 - rain speed reduction). Posted speed is only a free-flow proxy; fallback speeds are assumptions.
travel_time.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

number_of_intersections.local_evidence: Count traversed nodes with OSM street_count >= 3; exclude origin; current topology is a temporal surrogate.
number_of_intersections.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

traffic_signal.local_evidence: OSM traffic_signals tags; missing tags are assumed absent, not confirmed absent. Historical installations are unknown.
traffic_signal.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

road_type.local_evidence: OSM highway category; category costs and temporal stability are project assumptions.
road_type.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

time_of_day.local_evidence: Exact Asia/Manila request hour. A separate binary peak-hours cost uses assumed hours 07,08,17,18,19; it is not copied from congestion.
time_of_day.reference: Project policy in configs/study_assumptions.json (no empirical peak-hour validation)
time_of_day.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

weather.local_evidence: Nearest 0.05-degree provider grid to each city representative point; source measurement provenance is unverified. Rain speed reductions 7.5%/11.5% are reference-range midpoints, not local calibration.
weather.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

flood_risk.local_evidence: Maximum NOAH class intersecting the road / 3. No mapped overlap is not proof of safety; no hourly flood observations or bridge elevation correction.
flood_risk.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

road_capacity.local_evidence: c = directional lanes * 1900 * g/C. Assume g/C=0.5 at a tagged downstream signal, otherwise 1. Lane fallbacks and signal timings are unmeasured; unsignalized use is a proxy.
road_capacity.required_evidence: Estimates authorized; not independently validated historical measurements

note: Release readiness means the disclosed estimation pipeline is operational, not that historical traffic was measured or estimates calibrated.
